metadata.schedule_summary: Four 21 day cycles are planned, unless treatment stops or changes earlier. Day 1: carboplatin plus vinorelbine. Day 8: vinorelbine only. Your prescription specifies vinorelbine by drip OR capsules; these are alternatives, not extra doses.

eligibility: NSCLC locally advanced, recurrent or metastatic; cisplatin unsuitable. ECOG0-2 and adequate haematologic, renal and hepatic function.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity, pregnancy, breastfeeding, long-term oxygen therapy.
Significant absorption disease or gastric/small-bowel surgery requires caution for oral dosing.
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal/liver profile, peripheral neuropathy assessment and measured GFR(preferred) or verified estimate.
FBC, renal/liver and neuropathy before each cycle; product information adds FBC before each vinorelbine administration.
Calculated carboplatin GFR uses creatinine within48hours; isotope-GFR re-evaluation if creatinine>110% baseline.
Response imaging and follow-up are individually planned; no mandatory universal tumour-marker interval.
dose_modifications: Component-specific haematological, renal, hepatic and non-haematological pathways are encoded as independently actionable rules.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Select Day 1high-risk carboplatin combination, Day 8IVminimal or Day 8 oral-specific pathway.

treatment_phases.label: Prescribed IV vinorelbine alternative
treatment_phases.duration_text: Four 21-day cycles, or earlier disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. Select one vinorelbine route only.
treatment_phases.schedule_summary: IV vinorelbine on Days 1 and 8 plus carboplatin on Day 1. Do not add oral vinorelbine to this alternative.

administration.notes: NCCP starting dose 25 mg/m²; the treating physician may initiate or increase to 35 mg/m². Neither escalation nor reduction is automatic: verify the currently prescribed dose. Infuse in 50 mL sodium chloride 0.9% over 15 minutes, then flush with 250 mL sodium chloride 0.9%; pharmacy must reconcile the actual product administration policy.
Infuse in 500 mL glucose 5% over 30 minutes on Day 1 only. Verify the prescribed AUC and renal function separately; this view does not calculate a patient-specific dose.

treatment_phases.label: Prescribed oral vinorelbine alternative — starting dose shown
treatment_phases.duration_text: Four 21-day cycles, or earlier disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. Select one vinorelbine route only.
treatment_phases.schedule_summary: Oral vinorelbine on Days 1 and 8 plus IV carboplatin on Day 1. Oral 60 mg/m² is the source starting dose, not a presumed current prescription.

administration.notes: Starting dose 60 mg/m² (maximum 120 mg per administration). Only if well tolerated and prescribed, consider 80 mg/m² from cycle 2 or 3 (source capsule table maximum 160 mg). Confirm the currently prescribed dose before any dose-reduction calculation; do not automatically escalate or convert from IV. Swallow whole with water and some food; do not repeat a dose after vomiting.
Infuse in 500 mL glucose 5% over 30 minutes on Day 1 only. Verify the prescribed AUC and renal function separately; this view does not calculate a patient-specific dose.
